summary: Separate retained-directory helpers from catalog transactions.

replay.detail: Moves retained-directory path resolution and no-follow traversal into a private shared-driver module and points message and lock consumers there. Function bodies, platform branches, flags, errors and existing tests are unchanged; the old catalog-transaction public and crate-internal paths remain re-exported. No runtime, authority, schema, protocol or recovery behavior changes.
